correctness.rationale: For each blade vertex, the closed-neighborhood sum is exactly the center label plus the blade sum. Those inequalities imply the center inequality for at least two blades. The two center-label cases therefore factor independently by blades, and parity gives the exact minimum. The standalone exhaustive checker agrees with the raw graph definition on 188952 labelings across 226 parameter tuples and verifies every compared coefficient.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification on a graph family already used in signed-domination research. It gives the entire weight distribution, an exact blade-parity law, and the full minimum family for arbitrary unequal clique blades. That structural information is materially stronger than a scalar special case and is suitable for later forcing and extremal questions.
